mapper.sql: select tenant_id, tenant_name, contact_name, contact_phone, domain, status, expire_time, account_count, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from sys_tenant
mapper.insert: insert into sys_tenant( tenant_id, tenant_name, contact_name, contact_phone, domain, status, expire_time, account_count, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{tenantId}, #{tenantName}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{domain}, #{status}, #{expireTime}, #{accountCount}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )

INSERT INTO sys_dept (tenant_id, parent_id, dept_name, order_num, leader, phone, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, 0, #{tenantName}, 0, '管理员', '', '0', '0', 'admin', NOW())

INSERT INTO sys_role (tenant_id, role_name, role_key, role_sort, data_scope, menu_check_strictly, dept_check_strictly, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{roleName}, 'admin', 1, '1', 1, 1, '0', '0', 'admin', NOW())

INSERT INTO sys_role (tenant_id, role_name, role_key, role_sort, data_scope, menu_check_strictly, dept_check_strictly, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{roleName}, 'common', 2, '2', 1, 1, '0', '0', 'admin', NOW())

INSERT INTO sys_user (tenant_id, dept_id, user_name, nick_name, password, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{deptId}, #{userName}, #{nickName}, #{password}, '0', '0', 'admin', NOW())
INSERT INTO sys_user_role (tenant_id, user_id, role_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{roleId})

INSERT INTO sys_role_menu (tenant_id, role_id, menu_id) SELECT #{tenantId}, #{roleId}, menu_id FROM sys_menu WHERE NOT ( path IN ('tenant', 'open', 'mobile') OR path LIKE 'open/%' OR perms LIKE 'system:tenant:%' OR perms LIKE 'open:%' OR perms LIKE 'workflow:mobile:%' )

INSERT INTO sys_config (tenant_id, config_name, config_key, config_value, config_type, create_by, create_time, remark) SELECT #{tenantId}, config_name, config_key, config_value, config_type, 'admin', NOW(), remark FROM sys_config WHERE tenant_id = 1
